Through:

 Hon'Ble Mr. Justice Amit Sharma
 Or
% 18.05.2023
1.

The present petition under Section 482 of the Cr.P.C. seeks quashing of Fir No. 001/2023, under
Section 498A/406/34/377/354 of the Ipc, registered at P.S. Hauz Khas.

2.  Learned counsel appearing on behalf of the petitioner submits that a Memorandum of Understanding-cum-settlement deed dated 22.03.2023 has been arrived at between petitioner no. 1 and respondent no. 2.
It is further submitted that in pursuance of the said Memorandum of Understanding, respondent no. 2 has given no objection for quashing of the present FIR.
It is further pointed out that the parties have filed a petition seeking divorce by mutual consent and the first motion has been allowed.
3. Issue notice.
4. Learned APP for the State accepts notice and seeks some time to file the status report.
Let the same be filed before the next date of hearing.
